admitted.title: Data source file: Activation of skeletal muscle is controlled by a dual-filament mechano-sensing mechanism (Figures 1, 3, 4, 6)
admitted.license: CC-BY-4.0 (SPDX cc-by-4.0, as returned by the record API)
admitted.format: Office Open XML spreadsheet (.xlsx), 4 worksheets, embedded chart XML
admitted.subjects: in-vitro skeletal muscle fibres, RLC (regulatory light chain) and TNC probes; steady-state pCa series plus UV-flash force transients. Per-fibre n and species are NOT stated in the fetched record -> UNKNOWN (record text only names the probe type and the figures).
admitted.how: pCa (calcium activity, -log10) is swept against T/T0 and force in kPa, and force/length transients are time-resolved against a UV-flash origin. This is the shape of the C -> F coupling in F_target, and the time scale of calcium-driven force change. It contains no ischemia, so it constrains the coupling function, NOT any ischemic rate constant.

admitted.title: Data from: Anthrax toxin receptor 1 is essential for arteriogenesis in a mouse model of hindlimb ischemia
admitted.format: Excel .xlsx, 1 worksheet, 333 rows x 34 columns, figure-block layout
admitted.subjects: mouse hindlimb ischemia, wild-type and ANTXR1(-/-) mice, ligated vs contralateral leg, days -1, 0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 14, 21, 28; plus a human block labelled Non-ischemic / Bypass / Amputation. Per-group n is NOT stated in the record or in the file (the file stores 'Average' and 'st Dev' columns) -> UNKNOWN.
admitted.how: The only admitted deposit that pairs a longitudinal hindlimb-ischemia time axis (-1 to +28 d) with a matched contralateral limb, i.e. a measured ischemia-vs-normalised-limb contrast on the same animal - the structural analogue of the model's normalised flow q. The human block is a cohort-scale limb-ischemia sample.
admitted.caveat: The deposited sheet carries NO unit row and NO legend (unit scan = 0 hits), so the physical quantity behind each figure block is UNKNOWN from the deposit alone. DS02 is therefore admitted as a time-axis/cohort/contrast source, is NOT used as the verified sample (PREREG criterion 3 fails on 'units'), and no value from it is mapped onto q numerically.

admitted.format: ZIP archive of instrument raw files (not expanded or parsed in this session)

admitted.how: Directly measures cytosolic and SR Ca2+ in skeletal muscle across a loading/unloading cycle, i.e. the calcium compartment of the model. The cycle it observes is torpor-arousal, NOT ischemia: it constrains the existence, direction and reversibility of Ca2+ handling, and cannot supply an ischemic rate constant.

admitted.title: Data from: Noninvasive technique to evaluate the muscle fiber characteristics using q-space imaging (Dryad pp56ck7 / Zenodo 4936109)

admitted.how: GEOMETRY class: fibre-level structural quantities (fibre CSA / fibre-type composition) for the two muscles that carry the model's compartment. It fixes the structural SCALE of the compartment (how much tissue a normalised fraction acts on); it says nothing about the ischemic time course. Admitted under the geometry/anatomy row of the PREREG mapping table, which is the only row that does not require an ischemia manipulation.
